violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -In the main walk in cooler raw chicken above raw beef and raw fish on the north shelves. On the south shelves raw beef above vegetables.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -At the beginning of the inspection handwash sink was blocked with bottles and utensils.
Food supplies. — --Food item obtained from unapproved source. -2 jars of home canned pickles in the back walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -In the walk in cooler raw beef above cooked baked potatoes and cooked rice.
Food display protection, condiment protection, clean tableware usage, sign posted (1 pt deducted)
Approved, safe, unadulterated, approved additives, proper receiving temperature (4 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
